name: Six Senses Southern Dunes
positioning: Inland desert resort, officially Six Senses Southern Dunes, The Red Sea, on the historic incense trade route, with Nabataean-inspired architecture and pool villas among the Alnesai dunes
best_for: Travelers seeking a desert escape with adventure activities and village visits
Wellness-minded guests wanting a secluded pool villa with dune views

facts.text: The resort is one of two inland locations in The Red Sea Development Project on Saudi Arabia's west coast.
The resort is set among the Alnesai dunes.
Guest rooms and suites surround the main Oasis complex, with pool villas dotted around the resort.
Interiors reflect the tones and textures of the dunes, with soft furnishings drawing on the colors and patterns of traditional Bedouin tribal dress.
The resort is open all year round.
The signature restaurant serves flavors from Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Syria, Persia and Lebanon.
Destination dining is offered at out-of-the-ordinary locations in and around the resort.

highlights.text: The resort pays homage to Nabataean architectural heritage and its desert surroundings.
It sits along the historic incense trade route, against desert plains and the Hijaz Mountains.
The spa is set over two floors with self-shaded water surfaces.
Experiences range from immersing in village life to adventure activities in the desert.

considerations.text: This is an inland desert resort, not a beach resort on the Red Sea coast.
WhataHotel notes the remote desert location requires planned transportation.

sources.title: Six Senses Southern Dunes, The Red Sea
